workflow.name: Tenant Reminder (PMS)
workflow.description: Every day at 9:00 AM (Malaysia): reads active bookings from the Widebed PMS and sends the guest and owner emails due today (the 10 rules of the old n8n "Tenant Reminder"). Marks passcodes, utility bills and owner notices as sent in the PMS.

nodes.name: Active PMS bookings
nodes.notes: Every active offline booking (Create booking, direct bookings and Willow imports).

nodes.name: Work out today's emails
nodes.notes: Same rules as the n8n "Tenant Reminder" (Rules 1–10), using PMS fields. Dates are Malaysia time.

config.subject: NO-REPLY. Welcome to {{ $json.propertyName }}! Your access details are inside.
config.body:
Hi {{ $json.guestName }},

Welcome to your new home! We hope you had a smooth journey.

Your door passcode is now ACTIVE. Here is your "Quick Access" cheat sheet so you don't have to dig through old emails:

🔑 Quick Access Details

Unit: {{ $json.unitNumber }}
Door Passcode: {{ $json.mainDoorPasscode }}
Note: The # key is the UNLOCKING key on the keypad.
(Depending on your lock model, it may be #, *, or a Key Icon). Please press it after entering the numbers.

{{ $json.extrasHtml }}


{{ $json.whatsappHtml }}Important WhatsApp Contacts:
📌 Operations: Nicholas (+6012 822 3141)
📌 Accounts & Payment: Athira (+6012 550 3141)

🔔 Important Reminders

✅ Move-in & Move-out Procedures:

  • Contact our team for lift/parking card collection & return during move-out.
  • Please do not leave lift/parking cards or keys inside the unit. A RM100 penalty will apply if our team needs to unlock the door.

✅ Building Rules & Etiquette:

  • Do not leave trash in the common areas (e.g., corridors, lobby).
  • Avoid excessive noise in the evenings. Any penalties imposed by the building management due to non-compliance will be borne by the tenant.

✅ Communication & Support:

  • Expect delayed responses after working hours (9 AM – 6 PM, Monday to Friday).
  • Kindly use this group chat for all inquiries instead of private messaging.

🏡 Take Good Care of the Property

As the appointed property manager on behalf of the owner, our team will conduct regular inspections to ensure the property is well-maintained. We kindly ask you to:

  • 🏡 Treat the property as you would your own home.
  • 🧹 Keep the unit clean and tidy.
  • 🛠 Fix minor issues promptly.
  • 💡 Settle utility bills on time.
  • 💰 Ensure rental payments are made before the new month starts.

🔸 Any damages or additional cleaning required due to negligence will be deducted from the security deposit.


Thank you for your cooperation! 😊

This is an auto-generated email. For any inquiry, please direct them to our Whatsapp group.

Best regards,
Widebed Property Rental Management Team
"Happy Home Away from Home"

config.subject: NO-REPLY. Checkout Reminder: Instructions for your departure today
config.body:
Hi {{ $json.guestName }},

This is a gentle reminder that your tenancy for {{ $json.propertyName }} ({{ $json.unitNumber }}) ends today, {{ $json.checkOutDisplay }}.

To ensure a smooth checkout process and the full refund of your deposit (if applicable), please follow the steps below:

✅ Step 1: Before You Leave

  • Switch Off: Please turn off all lights, air conditioning, and electrical appliances.
  • Clear Up: Ensure the unit is tidy and no personal items are left behind.
  • Check: Verify that nothing is missing or broken inside the unit.

🔑 Step 2: Key & Card Return

Option A: Standard Checkout (No Parking Card)
Please leave all access cards and keys inside the room on the table.

Option B: If you have a Parking Card
Please leave ALL access cards (including the parking card) inside the Mailbox located at the Lobby.

📸 Step 3: Confirmation

Once you have left the keys/cards, please snap a photo and send it to our WhatsApp Group as proof of checkout.

🏃‍♂️ Exiting the Building

Don't worry about getting stuck—going to the lobby/exiting the building does not require an access card.

Thank you for staying with us! We hope you had a wonderful time. 😊

This is an auto-generated email. For any inquiry, please direct them to our Whatsapp group.

Best regards,
Widebed Property Rental Management Team
"Happy Home Away from Home"
